opening: I've been getting short of breath.
It started about a month ago.
I have a 30 pack-year smoking history.
Three months ago I started bucillamine, 200 mg a day, for my arthritis.
I had my mitral valve replaced a year ago.

opening.text: I've been getting short of breath. It started about a month ago. I had my mitral valve replaced a year ago, and three months ago I started taking bucillamine, 200 mg a day, for my arthritis. I also have a 30 pack-year smoking history.
